svg.title: Accessibility
svg.desc: The accessibility of an origin is the sum, over all destinations, of the opportunities at each destination times a weight that decays with the travel time. The travel time is a percentile of the per-departure times in seconds, from the same computation as the travel-time matrix but not rounded to minutes. Five weight functions are drawn against travel time in minutes for a 30 minute cutoff: step (1 below the cutoff, 0 from it), exponential (one half at the cutoff), fixed exponential (ignores the cutoff), linear (a ramp of the given width centred on the cutoff) and logistic (about one half at the cutoff, spread set by the standard deviation).
svg.text: one value per origin i, opportunity

opportunities_colnames (missing, zero or negative counts add nothing)

Weight against travel time (minutes). With "step", trips longer than the largest cutoff are not routed at all (max_trip_duration is lowered to it).
